subject: English
passage: Brain imaging research led by neuroscientist Kenji Yamamoto found that musicians showed heightened responses in the right temporal lobe (the portion of the brain associated with emotional processing) when exposed to unexpected tempo changes during concerts; ______ the musicians' responses were normal in rehearsal settings. These findings suggest that when performing for live audiences, musicians may experience intensified emotional engagement.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer because 'conversely' logically signals the contrast between the two conditions described. The text establishes that musicians showed heightened emotional responses in the right temporal lobe during concerts when exposed to unexpected tempo changes. The second clause presents the opposite finding: musicians' responses were normal in rehearsal settings. 'Conversely' appropriately indicates this opposing relationship, highlighting that the same musicians showed different brain responses depending on whether they were performing for live audiences or rehearsing.
